cat > /tmp/search_close_calls.sh << 'EOF'
#!/bin/bash

echo "=== Close() calls in non-test server code ==="
echo ""

# Find all Close() calls in non-test, non-generated code
find /bench/repo -name "*.go" -not -name "*_test.go" -not -path "*/proto/gen/*" | while read file; do
  grep -n "\.Close()" "$file" 2>/dev/null | while read line; do
    # Get relative path
    rel_path=$(echo "$file" | sed 's|/bench/repo/||')
    line_num=$(echo "$line" | cut -d: -f1)
    echo "$rel_path:$line_num: $line"
  done
done
EOF
chmod +x /tmp/search_close_calls.sh
